whisper.transcript: This robot escaped jail by melting. Scientists locked it inside a tiny cage. But instead of breaking the bars... It melted. Its entire body turned into liquid metal. Then, it slipped straight through the bars. Then, scientists collected the metal and molded it back into shape. How? It's made from a metal that melts near body temperature. and magnets help control its movement. Scientists are exploring whether robots like this could one day retrieve objects from inside your body. So apparently Even prison bars can't stop a robot anymore.
